record.original_question: A diffeomorphism between two strongly pseudoconvex CR (2n + 1)-manifolds is called quasiconformal if its differential preserves the underlying contact structures and distorts the CR structures boundedly. When Hermitian metrics on the contact bundles are fixed, this distortion can be measured by checking how spheres in the contact space is mapped to ellipsoids. However, this measurement depends on the choices of the Hermitian metrics if n > 1. Fixing a quasiconformal diffeomorphism, can we choose Hermitian metrics so that the distortion is minimal? - Puqi Tang, tang@math.purdue.edu

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M_1, H_1, J_1)$ and $(M_2, H_2, J_2)$ be two strongly pseudoconvex CR manifolds of dimension $2n+1$ with $n \geq 2$, where $H_i \subset TM_i$ is the contact (Levi) distribution of rank $2n$ and $J_i : H_i \to H_i$ is the CR (almost complex) structure on the contact bundle. A diffeomorphism $f : M_1 \to M_2$ is called CR-quasiconformal if its differential maps $H_1$ onto $H_2$ and the pullback CR structure $f^*J_2$ is boundedly close to $J_1$ on $H_1$. 

Given a Hermitian metric $g_i$ on $(H_i, J_i)$, define the pointwise distortion of $f$ at $p \in M_1$ as
$$K_{g_1,g_2}(f,p) \;=\; \frac{\max_{v \in H_{1,p},\, g_1(v,v)=1} g_2(df(v), df(v))}{\min_{v \in H_{1,p},\, g_1(v,v)=1} g_2(df(v), df(v))},$$
i.e. the eccentricity of the ellipsoid which is the image under $df_p$ of the unit sphere of $g_1$ in $H_{1,p}$, measured by $g_2$. Let
$$K_{g_1,g_2}(f) \;=\; \sup_{p \in M_1} K_{g_1,g_2}(f,p).$$
For $n \geq 2$, this number depends on the choice of the Hermitian metrics $g_1, g_2$ compatible with the CR structures.

Fix a CR-quasiconformal diffeomorphism $f : M_1 \to M_2$. Determine whether one can choose Hermitian metrics $g_1$ on $(H_1, J_1)$ and $g_2$ on $(H_2, J_2)$ that minimize the distortion $K_{g_1,g_2}(f)$, and if so describe such minimizing metrics and the resulting minimal distortion.
artifact.status_search_result: A search located the dissertation of Puqi Tang on quasiconformal homeomorphisms on CR manifolds and subsequent related work, but no source directly resolves the question of whether the Hermitian metrics on the contact bundles can be chosen to minimize the distortion of a fixed CR-quasiconformal diffeomorphism when $n \geq 2$. The current status appears unverified.

status_evidence.title: Quasiconformal homeomorphisms on Cauchy-Riemann manifolds (Puqi Tang dissertation)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops conformal distortion theory for quasiconformal homeomorphisms between CR 3-manifolds preserving contact structures; focuses on n=1 case via Legendrian moduli.
status_evidence.claim: Tang's foundational work treats the n=1 case; the metric-dependence of distortion arises for n>1, and no resolution of the minimization question for n>1 is indicated.
